ent_benchmark_humanoidbench.name: HumanoidBench
ent_benchmark_humanoidbench.summary: A simulated benchmark for whole-body humanoid locomotion and manipulation based on the Unitree H1 robot, providing over 40 tasks for controlled comparison of VLA and control algorithms.
ent_benchmark_humanoidbench.body:
## Overview

HumanoidBench is a full-body humanoid locomotion and manipulation simulation benchmark built on the Unitree H1 robot morphology, comprising over 40 tasks that cover four capability categories: locomotion, reaching/manipulation, mobile manipulation, and dexterous hand tasks. It provides a unified evaluation environment for VLA models and control algorithms through controlled comparison, and is currently one of the most widely cited full-body humanoid control simulation benchmarks.

ent_benchmark_libero_plus.name: LIBERO-Plus
ent_benchmark_libero_plus.summary: A robustness benchmark for Vision-Language-Action models that extends LIBERO with 10,030 tasks across seven perturbation dimensions including camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language, lighting, background, noise, and object layout.
ent_benchmark_libero_plus.body:
## Overview

LIBERO-Plus is a robustness evaluation benchmark for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, extended from LIBERO, scaling the task suite to **10,030 tasks** and systematically applying pressure across seven perturbation dimensions: camera viewpoint, robot initial state, language instructions, lighting, background, sensor noise, and object layout. What it truly changes is not merely "more tasks," but rather shifting the evaluation paradigm from "how quickly it learns" to "how stable it remains under perturbation"—making model vulnerabilities locatable, attributable, and comparable.
